Japan's Senate narrowly rejects censure motion against Education Minister Seki

Yoshihiro Seki · Politics

Key opposition parties say they will keep pursuing accountability despite the setback. The censure motion targeted Education Minister Yoshihiro Seki, who is caught in a scandal. The vote was narrow.

Reported by The Straits Times; Bloomberg.
